method: Agent-operated real browser through application controls, using the real local SQLite HTTP service

checks.name: Fresh workspace shows no fabricated ingestion or findings
Sample ingestion produces 11 retained rows, 4 usable, 5 quarantined, 2 duplicates and 8/9 coverage
MES-004 lineage exposes source filename, row ordinal, records[3], raw payload and source hash
A sourced unit proposal records revision 2 without changing the measurement
Operator review controls are disabled; switching to Reviewer enables rationale and decision
Approval changes the overlay to degrees Celsius and version 2 while the raw degC value remains
Audit verification reconciles 11 raw rows, 3 audit events and 9 current measurements
Actual six-file evidence ZIP downloads and passes independent extraction and replay verification
Reload restores the SQL workspace at revision 3 and the approved correction
Unsupported JSON import displays an error and preserves the existing workspace
Follow-up pressure ingestion closes the missing slot to 9/9 and retains prior finding history
Observer can inspect evidence while ingestion controls are disabled
Overview, source intake and method remain within the 390 by 844 viewport; wide tables and navigation scroll internally
Mobile lineage dialog remains usable and closes with Escape
Downloaded sample JSON re-imports through the file chooser as an idempotent replay, preserving revision 4 and 12 rows
The final fresh preview tab records no browser warnings or errors

observations: Real browser inspection exposed horizontal overflow from the offscreen table heading's absolutely positioned accessibility label. Positioning the scroll container fixed the document width while retaining internal scrolling.
A temporary Vite restart left one tab on a connection-error page. A fresh tab restored the saved workspace; no network or browser security settings were changed.
scope: Synthetic scenarios and basic responsive/keyboard checks. Not a full accessibility audit or independent human validation.
